program.name: Strong Balance
program.subject: Balance & stability
program.blurb: Balance with load: single-leg lifts with dumbbells, then hip and inner-thigh strength.
program.about: Balance that holds up under load. One day is single-leg work with dumbbells: split squats, single-leg deadlifts and step-ups. The other strengthens the hips and inner thighs that keep the knee steady: Copenhagen planks, side-lying adductions and clamshells. Abs finish every session. Level II asks for heavier weights and Level III adds reps.
